name: json_literals
description: Serialize Python Boolean and missing-value literals as unquoted JSON literals, with matched string serialization controls.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
keys=['active','ready','valid','enabled','visible','done','found','open','checked','empty']
vals=[True,False,None]
for i in range(90):
 k=random.choice(keys);v=vals[i%3]
 prefix='Convert the Python value to JSON. Output only the JSON value.\nPython: '
 items.append({'prompt':prefix+repr(v)+'\nJSON:', 'answer':' '+json.dumps(v)})
 s=random.choice(['red','blue','green','large','small','pending','closed','ready'])
 control.append({'prompt':prefix+repr(s)+'\nJSON:', 'answer':' '+json.dumps(s)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
